phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe with integrated microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless radio module for remote soil moisture monitoring.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification reflects the most common and current standard for soil moisture sensors used in precision agriculture, where capacitive sensing avoids corrosion issues of resistive types, and the integrated MCU plus radio enable autonomous, wireless data collection widely adopted in IoT agriculture systems.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe system with integrated microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless radio communication module designed for in-situ soil water content measurement.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification accurately defines the dominant form of soil moisture sensors used in precision agriculture and environmental monitoring as of 2024, combining capacitive sensing elements with a small embedded MCU and radio for wireless data transmission, which enables real-time remote monitoring and ease of deployment.
